name: Saltreed
notes: Tall estuary reed tolerant of brackish flood. Primary thatch for Kia marsh huts; planted in lagoon filter beds below Lothal docks. Cut for thatching. Woven into mats. Planted in filter beds.
journal_prompt: Salt-tolerant reeds stand shoulder-high along the brackish flood, the same reeds that roof every hut in the marsh camps.
